title: Dino's Expansion
description: welcome to Dino's expansion where you can upgrade your worlds with chaos
body:
![the Full Dino's Expansion Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9199e8bdd1cc83b25d95e9d5eef78a8395f3c786.png)


this mod adds in new blocks, items, biomes, ores and new mechanics to explore.

find new structures to conquer and loot, craft new blocks with intersitng mechanices to use in your next survival base or maybie you just want to just decorate your base with new plants just to feel cozy inside because why not.

if you like brewing poitions maybie try brewing Tea instead its way better more with fun new side effects.

this mod is basicly part 2 of my other mod from curseforge known as Chaos Overhaul so this mods other name is just Chaos Overhaul 2 witch just sounds weird.

plans: new mobs, more structures, more ores, more biomes, more plants, more everything really
